name: State Data Center Belgrade
developer: Office for IT and eGovernment / Telekom Srbija
notes: Serbia's first state-owned data center, opened in Belgrade in partnership with Telekom Srbija for consolidated e-government infrastructure.

name: CETIN Serbia Belgrade Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral Belgrade data center at Omladinskih brigada 90/92; CETIN describes it as Serbia's largest interconnection hub with 99.9999% service availability. Data Center Map lists Tier 3.

name: Telekom Srbija / MTS Belgrade Data Center
notes: Commercial colocation facility at Katiceva 14-18 in Belgrade. Public directories list roughly 2,000+ sq m and 4 MW; official MTS page confirms data center services but capacity is from directory/marketplace sources.

name: SBB Telepark Data Center
notes: Telepark Belgrade colocation/telehousing facility; public listings describe 750 sq m of data center space, 20 server halls, and about 1.6 MW fully built-out power.

name: Orion Telekom Belgrade Data Center
notes: Baxtel nearby-facility listing identifies Orion Telekom's Belgrade data center at Naselje Zemun Polje, Mala pruga 8 as a Tier 3 facility designed by Schneider Electric and built by Enel-PS.

name: phoenixNAP Belgrade Data Center
notes: Belgrade facility at Omladinskih brigada 92; phoenixNAP announced the European facility in 2016/2017 and marketplace sources list 1.2 MW public power capacity.

name: NetCast Data Center
notes: NetCast states it operates its own modern certified data center in central Belgrade for server housing and telecom equipment; Data Center Catalog lists the facility at Milentija Popovica 9 with two connected data centers built in 2013.

name: Government Data Centre in Kragujevac
developer: Office for IT and eGovernment, Government of Serbia
notes: Tier/Class 4 government and commercial data center campus in Kragujevac. Official sources describe two facilities totaling about 14,000 sq m, 1,080 racks, global users including Oracle, IBM, Huawei and CERN, and 14 MW capacity after new modules/supercomputer activation.

name: Government Data Centre Kragujevac expansion with e& enterprise
developer: Office for IT and eGovernment / e& enterprise
notes: Strategic MoU to add up to 40 MW of hyperscale-ready capacity to the existing 14 MW Tier-4 Kragujevac campus; official e& announcement says land is secured for the future expansion block.

name: City Data Center Kragujevac
developer: City of Kragujevac / Huawei-supported China donation
notes: Municipal city cloud/data center launched in Kragujevac with Huawei participation and a reported USD 2 million China donation; supports city administration, smart city services, backup, virtualization, University of Kragujevac and other users.
